about: Batch 3b (the Common Room's and My Room's evening and night) written early on 7 Oct 2026 at the owner's word, from the two day pictures the owner chose in 3a, which are NOT installed: art_batch.write_batch(data, '3b', record, manifest, out, preview=True, root=<a scratch root>) with the chosen pictures fitted to 1920x1080 as that root's game/images/bg/dorm_common.png and your_room.png, and a scratch manifest putting both at revision 2 or more. Judge the results with tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py --relight <place> <evening|night> <a> <b> --dry --against <the chosen day picture>, then by eye.

read_7_oct.install_redo_dry: all eight pass (the Common Room's four PASS; My Room's four LOOK, for the laptop).

by_eye.dorm_common_evening: both faithful; A is the calmer (B has a light shaft and an orange reflection on the television)
by_eye.dorm_common_night: B is faithful; A ADDS a blanket over the sofa's arm, which the check did not catch
by_eye.your_room_evening: B is the better: in A the right-hand window still shows daylight-green trees beside a sunset in the other window
by_eye.your_room_night: A is faithful; B ADDS a lit desk lamp and turns the walls blue, which the check did not catch

read_7_oct.my_picks: Common Room: evening A, night B. My Room: evening B, night A. The owner had not chosen yet when this was written.
read_7_oct.for_the_installer: two more blind spots, the other way round from art_3a_early.json: an addition on the sofa's arm and one on the desk beside the laptop's allow box both passed. The relight wording itself works: nothing moved in any of the eight, and no window shows daylight except My Room evening A's right-hand one.
